# Purchased-part CAD provenance

The project uses actual catalogue parts and package dimensions. CAD describes **nominal geometry**, with the explicit detail limits below. Printed clearances need a physical fit check before ordering an assembled production run.

| Model | Source and dimensions | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Waveshare 19192 | [Official 3D archive](https://files.waveshare.com/upload/4/49/1.28inch_LCD_Module_3D_Drawing.zip), `0508.stp`, 2021-05-08; [product](https://www.waveshare.com/product/1.28inch-lcd-module.htm) | Original STEP retained as `step/Waveshare-19192.stp`. Unscaled tessellation: 40.453106×37.5×9.2 mm. Supplier's simplified solid includes PCB, front, rear connector and four mounting bosses. Fine connector/contact details are absent from the supplier file. Colours are ours. |
| JST B6B-PH (installed) / S8B-PH (historical) | KiCad `Connector_JST.3dshapes`; [official JST PH drawing](https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/ePH.pdf) | Pitch 2 mm; PH6 width 13.9 mm/top-entry height 6 mm; PH8 width 17.9 mm/side-entry height 4.85 mm in the STEP. Through-hole tails in the derivative OBJ are trimmed to 0.8 mm below a 1.6 mm PCB. Original untrimmed STEP retained. |
| ICs and passive packages | KiCad package STEP files in `step/`; per-file URLs in `models.json` | LQFP48, narrow SOIC8, SOT23-5/6, SC70-6, SOD323, 0402/0603/0805. Lead geometry and package sizes come from those STEP files; material colours are ours. These are package-level models, not serial-number-specific manufacturer solids. |
| HRO USB-C | Exact imported EasyEDA models from the original component packages in `imports/` | Retain supplier copper, drilling, model orientation and offsets; E2 omits the two front body-ink strokes that overhang the USB tab. Original public OBJ and STEP copies are included (C165948; unused C720477 assets retained from the earlier revision); watertight STEP tessellations in `solid/` support collision checks because the display OBJ exports contain open material seams. Their coordinate bounds agree. |
| TCUT1600X01_A | [Vishay drawing p.6](https://www.vishay.com/docs/84174/tcut1600x01.pdf) | Datasheet-derived nominal 5.5×4×5.7 mm, 3 mm optical gap, 4.5 mm beam height. Fine moulding, optical lenses and lead-form details omitted. |
| Omron B3U-3000P | [Omron B3U datasheet](https://omronfs.omron.com/en_US/ecb/products/pdf/en-b3u.pdf); KiCad `Button_Switch_SMD.3dshapes/SW_SPST_B3U-3000P.step` | Side-actuated SMT model; body 3×2.5×1.2 mm, total terminal span 4 mm, actuator reaches local +Y1.95 mm. Footprint uses 0.9×1.7 mm lands at X±1.7 mm; rotated 180° on the PCB to face front. Collision tessellation preserves the valid STEP’s distinct coincident seam edges through Manifold half-edge pairing; vertices and dimensions are unchanged. E3 moves this unscaled package to the front tab and exposes its original 1.7×1.0 mm actuator. No separate plunger/cap. Actual direct access, actuator tolerance and force require measurement. |
| Supplied LCD lead | [Waveshare 19192 package list](https://www.waveshare.com/product/1.28inch-lcd-module.htm), [manufacturer cable photo](https://www.waveshare.com/img/devkit/accessories/PH2.0-wire-20cm-8PIN.jpg) | Includes PH2.0 8-pin / individual jumper-socket lead, nominal 20 cm. E3 shortens that lead and solders its board end; no extra cable or crimps. Original display plug is represented by the nominal JST PH envelope. Wire OD, sleeves, conductor and bend data are unpublished: Ø1 mm wire, simplified bare ends/contacts and 2 mm dressing bend are explicit design envelopes, not supplier CAD or qualified stock dimensions. Actual cable must be measured before fit signoff. |
| Optional J6 header | Würth 61300811021 [drawing](https://www.we-online.com/components/products/datasheet/61300811021.pdf); KiCad `PinHeader_1x08_P2.54mm_Horizontal.step` | Optional DNP; absent from compact assembly. 8 positions / 2.54 pitch, 20.32 mm row length, 6 mm post, 1.5 mm offset and 2.54 mm housing section. KiCad package-level geometry retained with 0.8 mm trimmed tails. Original STEP is retained. No claim of a serial-specific Würth model. |
| Bearing | 6712ZZ catalogue 60×75×7 mm | Envelope retained; race internals/shields are simplified. Printed race fits require the coupon and an actual bearing. |
| Screws | DIN 965 / ISO 7046-1 M2, 3.8 mm head diameter, 1.2 mm head height | Nominal screw bodies, threads/drive detail omitted. The printed 4.2 mm countersinks leave clearance. |

The screen is rigidly transformed by `diag(-1,+1,-1)` then translated to Z=17.75 mm: its tab points -X, PCB underside is Z=17.3 mm, front is Z=20.9 mm and rear connector reaches Z=11.7 mm. No axis has been rescaled. This orientation allows a short cable to J6 and requires the matching Rev E3 bezel support pattern and MADCTL setting.

## Rebuilding

`generate-models.py` imports the listed KiCad STEP files from `/usr/share/kicad/3dmodels` and tessellates at 0.03 mm chordal deflection through `../step-mesh.py`; `custom-models.py` generates the documented nominal sensor model and retained historical toggle model. Runtime: Python 3.12, `cadquery-ocp==8.0.1.1.0`, `trimesh==5.2.0`, `numpy`, `manifold3d==3.5.4`. The checked-in source STEP/OBJ files permit inspection without a KiCad installation. `models.json` records local paths, upstream URLs and measured bounds.

The supplier screen OBJ is an unchanged geometry tessellation of the original STEP; only vertex colours were added. Regenerate it with `step-mesh.py` and retain its source frame; the assembly generator applies the rigid transform.

## Rights

Original Waveshare CAD remains Waveshare material, supplied in its public module resources; it is not relicensed as project MIT code. The KiCad STEP headers retain their authors, CC-BY-SA-4.0 licence and ECAD design exception. Those notices also apply to derivative package meshes; the exception permits generated electronic designs without imposing the library's share-alike licence on this project. Other supplier/EasyEDA assets retain their existing rights. Our parametric geometry and scripts are MIT. See the original STEP headers and [KiCad licence](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-packages3D/-/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
